purpose: Development-only protocol-review fixture for ServiceNow Platform MCP static readonly packaging versus SchemaRouter query-driven preselection. Not held-out evidence.

field_metric.definition: Recall over required top-level MCP input parameters declared in the frozen case labels and present in the exact selected upstream inputSchema.
field_metric.output_field_recall: not scored unless the upstream MCP schema exposes domain-level output field contracts
field_metric.reason: Do not invent ServiceNow domain output fields that are absent from the native MCP tool contract.

exposure_definition.serialization: canonical JSON with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':')
exposure_definition.value: Exact upstream MCP tool contracts made model-visible for the condition. Both conditions serialize the same captured upstream contracts; only the selected subset may differ.
